Position: UI/UX Designer

Position Summary
We are seeking a talented UI/UX Designer to join Nexion Labs, a rapidly growing enterprise software company building next-generation workflow and analytics products for large financial and healthcare clients. The UI/UX Designer will own the end-to-end visual and interaction design for core product modules, translating complex user needs into elegant, usable interfaces. This role requires close collaboration with product managers, engineers, and user researchers to create high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes that drive measurable improvements in user satisfaction and task efficiency. The ideal candidate brings 4-7 years of experience building design solutions for complex, data-rich applications and is fluent in Figma and modern prototyping techniques.

Key Responsibilities

Product Design & Strategy
- Partner with product managers and business stakeholders to define user problems, product goals, and design priorities.
- Contribute to product roadmaps by identifying UX opportunities and proposing design-led solutions that align with business objectives.
- Facilitate and participate in design discovery sessions, workshops, and stakeholder reviews.

Interaction & Visual Design
- Create user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity visual designs, and interactive prototypes to communicate interaction models and design intent.
- Design responsive, accessible interfaces for complex workflows, dashboards, and data visualization components.
- Ensure consistency and quality across screens, states, and platforms through attention to visual detail and interaction patterns.

Prototyping & Validation
- Rapidly prototype features and interactions to validate concepts with internal stakeholders and end users.
- Work with user researchers to design and run usability tests; iterate designs based on qualitative and quantitative feedback.
- Translate test findings into actionable design improvements and document rationale for design decisions.

Design Systems & Cross-Functional Enablement
- Contribute to and evolve a shared design system, including reusable components, patterns, and documentation.
- Collaborate with engineering to ensure pixel-accurate implementation and maintain design-engineering alignment throughout development cycles.
- Provide assets, specifications, and guidance to development teams to ensure consistent implementation.

Project Delivery & Documentation
- Estimate design effort, manage multiple concurrent design tasks, and deliver on deadlines in an agile environment.
- Maintain comprehensive design documentation, including interaction specs, accessibility considerations, and handoff artifacts.
- Support product launches by preparing design artifacts, creating demo flows, and addressing post-release UX feedback.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 4-7 years of professional experience in UI/UX design, product design, or interaction design roles for enterprise or consumer-facing products.

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
- Figma
- Prototyping

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Adobe XD
- UI/UX Design
- Design Systems
- Adobe Photoshop

Success Metrics
- Time-to-first-interaction and task completion rates: measurably reduced time and clicks required for primary user tasks after design iterations.
- Usability scores: demonstrable improvement in SUS or comparable usability metrics from baseline to post-release.
- Design system adoption: percentage of product UI built from shared components and documented patterns.
- Delivery predictability: on-time delivery of design milestones across sprints with high stakeholder satisfaction.
- User engagement and retention: positive impact on product engagement metrics (e.g., increased DAU/MAU or reduced churn) attributable to UX improvements.

Location & Work Mode
Bengaluru, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
